record.original_question: Characterize injective C0-semigroups via the backward uniqueness property, and apply the resulting criteria to non-autonomous Cauchy problems u'(t) = A(t)u(t) with sectorial A(t) by analyzing the corresponding evolution semigroup.

evidence.quote: Problem 27 (Backward uniqueness property). Study the ”backward uniqueness property”, i.e., characterize injective C0 -semigroups. Apply the results to the backward uniqueness property for non-autonomous Cauchy problems u′ (t) = A(t)u(t), where A(t) is sectorial, by examining the corresponding evolution semigroup. See Lunardi’s work on evolution equations in Banach spaces [5].

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a Banach space and let $(T(t))_{t\ge 0}$ be a strongly continuous semigroup of bounded linear operators on $X$ (i.e., a $C_0$-semigroup), with infinitesimal generator $A$. The semigroup is said to have the backward uniqueness property if, for every $t>0$, the operator $T(t):X\to X$ is injective; equivalently, whenever $u:[0,\infty)\to X$ is a mild solution of $u'(t)=Au(t)$ with $u(t_0)=0$ for some $t_0>0$, then $u(t)=0$ for all $t\ge 0$.

(a) Give a characterization of those $C_0$-semigroups $(T(t))_{t\ge 0}$ on $X$ that are injective (equivalently, that have the backward uniqueness property), expressed in terms of properties of the generator $A$, the resolvent of $A$, or the spectral/structural properties of $(T(t))_{t\ge 0}$.

(b) Consider a non-autonomous Cauchy problem
$$u'(t)=A(t)u(t),\qquad t\in I\subseteq\mathbb{R},$$
on $X$, where for each $t$ the operator $A(t)$ is sectorial (so that a parabolic evolution family $\{U(t,s)\}_{t\ge s}$ is associated with the family $(A(t))$). Define the corresponding evolution semigroup $(T(\tau))_{\tau\ge 0}$ on a suitable space of $X$-valued functions on $I$ by
$$(T(\tau)f)(t)=U(t,t-\tau)f(t-\tau).$$
Using the characterization obtained in (a), provide necessary and sufficient conditions on the family $(A(t))$ ensuring that each propagator $U(t,s)$ is injective, i.e., the non-autonomous Cauchy problem has the backward uniqueness property.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of fully characterizing injective $C_0$-semigroups (the backward uniqueness property) appears to remain open as a general program. Backward uniqueness is established case by case for specific PDE systems (e.g., parabolic-hyperbolic fluid-structure interactions) and certain analytic semigroup classes, but no general characterization in terms of the generator is known, and the corresponding application to non-autonomous problems with sectorial $A(t)$ via the evolution semigroup is still actively studied.

status_evidence.title: Backward uniqueness of the s.c. semigroup arising in parabolic-hyperbolic fluid-structure interaction
status_evidence.snippet: Backward uniqueness property established for a specific coupled PDE semigroup; treated case by case rather than via a general characterization.
status_evidence.claim: Backward uniqueness for C0-semigroups is studied for specific systems, suggesting absence of a complete general characterization.

status_evidence.title: Münster Journal of Mathematics, Vol 5 (2012)
status_evidence.snippet: Studies of injectivity and inversion related to C0-semigroup generators.
status_evidence.claim: Related work indicates the characterization question is still being investigated.
